I can't confirm Amr Moussa or any other Secretary General for this award, and I'm withdrawing my earlier answer, which rested on unverified snippets. A fresh search found no record of an "Arab Creativity Oscar" from an Arab Creativity Union in Egypt, or of Mishary Alafasy receiving one, and the closest match was the [Sharjah Award for Arab Creativity](https://sdc.gov.ae/en/media-center/news/14/4/2025/sharjah-celebrates-the-winners-of-the-sharjah-award-for-arab-creativity), a different prize. The team note about Arab League patronage is also unverified, so the premise may be wrong; checking Arab League or Arab Creativity Union records would settle it.

CONFIDENCE: 15
